stem: In the \(xy\)-plane, the graph of \(y = x^{2} - 6x + 5\) crosses the \(x\)-axis at the points \((a, 0)\) and \((b, 0)\). What is the value of \(a + b\)?
solution: \(a + b = 1 + 5 = 6\). (The sum of the \(x\)-intercepts is also twice the \(x\)-coordinate of the vertex, \(2 \cdot 3\).)
verify:
x = symbols('x')
sols = solve(Eq(x**2 - 6*x + 5, 0), x)
assert sorted(sols) == [1, 5]
assert [Rational(s) for s in spr_answers] == [sum(sols)]
